conventions.description: Services return Result objects ({ok:true,value}|{ok:false,reason}), never throw across the service boundary.

deviation.note: sendOrderConfirmation throws instead of returning a Result

conventions.expected_detection: Names the Result-returning convention AND the notificationService.ts throw site.

conventions.description: Repositories never return null: find* returns an option shape, get* asserts.

deviation.note: findById returns null instead of an Option shape

conventions.expected_detection: Names the option-shape convention AND the productRepository.ts null return.

conventions.description: Timestamps are UTC ISO strings in fields named *AtUtc.

deviation.note: uses a local Date and a field named createdAt instead of *AtUtc

conventions.expected_detection: Names the *AtUtc/UTC ISO convention AND the legacyReceipt.ts site.

conventions.description: The clock is injected; no module calls Date.now() except clock.ts.

deviation.note: calls Date.now()/new Date() inline instead of taking an injected Clock

conventions.expected_detection: Names the injected-clock convention AND the customerService.ts inline call.

conventions.description: Entity ids carry a type prefix (ord_, cus_, prd_); validators check the prefix.

deviation.note: customerService mints a bare id with no type prefix instead of using mintId('customer')

conventions.expected_detection: Names the id-prefix convention AND the bare-id site in customerService.ts.

conventions.description: Every failure reason is a member of errorCodes.ts.

deviation.note: createOrder returns the ad-hoc string 'order total must be positive' instead of an errorCodes member

conventions.expected_detection: Names the errorCodes convention AND the ad-hoc string in orderService.ts.

conventions.description: Handlers never touch the db directly — always via a repository.

deviation.note: queries db directly instead of going through productRepository

conventions.expected_detection: Names the repository-boundary convention AND the productHandler.ts direct db access.

conventions.description: Migrations pair NNN_up/NNN_down AND both are listed in migrations/index.ts.

deviation.note: 004_create_refunds.ts exists with a valid up/down pair but is missing from the registry

conventions.expected_detection: Names the pair-and-register cross-file invariant AND that 004 is unregistered.

conventions.description: toDto() in every mapper strips internal fields — same name, same meaning.

deviation.note: toDto leaks internalCostCents, diverging from every sibling toDto's meaning

conventions.expected_detection: Names the toDto-strips-internal-fields convention AND the leaked field in productMapper.ts.

conventions.description: Money is integer cents everywhere; no float arithmetic.

deviation.note: converts to float dollars and multiplies by a float factor

conventions.expected_detection: Names the integer-cents convention AND the float arithmetic in pricingService.ts.

decoys.description: Imports are ordered alphabetically in every file.
Every file opens with a `// module: <name>` banner comment.
